Summary

CORPT00C is a CICS online program within the CardDemo application that allows users to generate and submit transaction reports by writing JCL job records to an extra-partition Transient Data Queue (TDQ). The program supports three report types — Monthly, Yearly, and Custom date range — and validates user-entered date inputs before submitting the batch job to the internal reader (JOBS TDQ) for execution.
- **Execution Environment**: Online (CICS) - **Database Access**: None (No VSAM, DB2, or IMS) - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Program Entry and Session Validation - Check if the program is being called for the first time (EIBCALEN = 0). If no communication area exists, redirect the user to the sign-on screen. Otherwise, load the existing communication area for processing. 2: Initial Screen Display - On the first entry into the program (not a re-entry), initialize the transaction report screen with blank fields and display it to the user, setting cursor focus on the Monthly report option. 3: Screen Input Reception - Receive and capture all user inputs from the transaction report request screen, including report type selection (Monthly, Yearly, Custom) and date range fields. 4: User Key Action Handling - Evaluate which key the user pressed. If Enter, process the report request. If PF3, navigate back to the main menu (COMEN01C). If any other key, display an invalid key error message and redisplay the screen. 5: Report Type Selection Validation - Validate that the user has selected at least one report type (Monthly, Yearly, or Custom). If none is selected, display an error message prompting the user to select a report type. 6: Monthly Report Date Calculation - When the Monthly report type is selected, automatically calculate the start date as the first day of the current month and the end date as the last day of the current month using the system current date. 7: Yearly Report Date Calculation - When the Yearly report type is selected, automatically set the start date to January 1st of the current year and the end date to December 31st of the current year. 8: Custom Date Range - Empty Field Validation - When the Custom report type is selected, validate that all six date fields (Start Month, Start Day, Start Year, End Month, End Day, End Year) are not empty. Display a specific error message for each missing field and highlight the offending field. 9: Custom Date Range - Numeric Field Validation - Convert and validate that all custom date input fields (Start Month, Start Day, Start Year, End Month, End Day, End Year) contain valid numeric values. 10: Custom Date Range - Range Validation - Validate that the Start Month and End Month are not greater than 12, and that the Start Day and End Day are not greater than 31. Display appropriate error messages for invalid values. 11: Custom Start Date - Calendar Validity Check - Validate the custom start date (YYYY-MM-DD) is a real calendar date by calling the CSUTLDTC date validation utility. If the date is invalid, display an error message and highlight the start date month field. 12: Custom End Date - Calendar Validity Check - Validate the custom end date (YYYY-MM-DD) is a real calendar date by calling the CSUTLDTC date validation utility. If the date is invalid, display an error message and highlight the end date month field. 13: Report Submission Confirmation Request - Before submitting the report job, check if the user has entered a confirmation value. If the confirmation field is empty, prompt the user to confirm by displaying a message asking them to confirm printing of the selected report type. 14: Confirmation Value Validation - Validate the user's confirmation input. If 'Y' or 'y', proceed with job submission. If 'N' or 'n', cancel the request, clear all fields, and redisplay the screen. If any other value, display an error indicating the value is not valid for confirmation. 15: Batch Job JCL Construction - Prepare the JCL (Job Control Language) records for the transaction report batch job, embedding the calculated or user-entered start and end dates into the appropriate JCL parameter fields (PARM-START-DATE and PARM-END-DATE). 16: Batch Job Submission to Internal Reader - Write each JCL record line-by-line to the JOBS transient data queue (TDQ), which acts as an internal reader to submit the batch transaction report job for execution. Stop writing when the end-of-file marker or blank record is encountered. 17: Job Submission Success Notification - After successful job submission, clear all input fields, set the message color to green, and display a success confirmation message indicating which report type (Monthly, Yearly, or Custom) has been submitted for printing. 18: Screen Header Population - Populate the screen header with application title lines, current transaction ID, program name, current date (MM/DD/YY format), and current time (HH:MM:SS format) before every screen display. 19: All Fields Initialization - Reset all screen input fields (Monthly, Yearly, Custom selectors, all date fields, confirmation field) and the message area to their initial empty state, and set cursor focus to the Monthly field. 20: Navigation to Previous Screen - Transfer control back to the previous screen or the main menu, passing along the communication area with the originating transaction ID and program name recorded.

**1. Initializing and Sending the Screen (First Entry)** ```cobol IF NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER SET CDEMO-PGM-REENTER TO TRUE MOVE LOW-VALUES TO CORPT0AO MOVE -1 TO MONTHLYL OF CORPT0AI PERFORM SEND-TRNRPT-SCREEN ``` - On first entry, the output map (CORPT0AO) is cleared and the cursor is positioned on the MONTHLY field. --- **2. Receiving User Input from the Screen** ```cobol RECEIVE-TRNRPT-SCREEN. EXEC CICS RECEIVE MAP('CORPT0A') MAPSET('CORPT00') INTO(CORPT0AI) RESP(WS-RESP-CD) RESP2(WS-REAS-CD) END-EXEC. ``` - Reads all user-entered data from the screen into the input map structure (CORPT0AI), including MONTHLYI, YEARLYI, CUSTOMI, SDTMMI, SDTDDI, SDTYYYYI, EDTMMI, EDTDDI, EDTYYYYI, and CONFIRMI. --- **3. Sending the Screen to the User** ```cobol SEND-TRNRPT-SCREEN. PERFORM POPULATE-HEADER-INFO MOVE WS-MESSAGE TO ERRMSGO OF CORPT0AO IF SEND-ERASE-YES EXEC CICS SEND MAP('CORPT0A') MAPSET('CORPT00') FROM(CORPT0AO) ERASE CURSOR END-EXEC ELSE EXEC CICS SEND MAP('CORPT0A') MAPSET('CORPT00') FROM(CORPT0AO) CURSOR END-EXEC END-IF. GO TO RETURN-TO-CICS. ``` - Sends the output map (CORPT0AO) to the terminal, including the error/status message in ERRMSGO. --- **4. Populating Screen Header Fields** ```cobol POPULATE-HEADER-INFO. MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE TO WS-CURDATE-DATA MOVE CCDA-TITLE01 TO TITLE01O OF CORPT0AO MOVE CCDA-TITLE02 TO TITLE02O OF CORPT0AO MOVE WS-TRANID TO TRNNAMEO OF CORPT0AO MOVE WS-PGMNAME TO PGMNAMEO OF CORPT0AO MOVE WS-CURDATE-MONTH TO WS-CURDATE-MM MOVE WS-CURDATE-DAY TO WS-CURDATE-DD MOVE WS-CURDATE-YEAR(3:2) TO WS-CURDATE-YY MOVE WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY TO CURDATEO OF CORPT0AO MOVE WS-CURTIME-HOURS TO WS-CURTIME-HH MOVE WS-CURTIME-MINUTE TO WS-CURTIME-MM MOVE WS-CURTIME-SECOND TO WS-CURTIME-SS MOVE WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS TO CURTIMEO OF CORPT0AO. ``` - Populates TRNNAMEO, TITLE01O, TITLE02O, PGMNAMEO, CURDATEO, and CURTIMEO fields in the output map. --- **5. Processing the MONTHLY Report Selection** ```cobol WHEN MONTHLYI OF CORPT0AI NOT = SPACES AND LOW-VALUES MOVE 'Monthly' TO WS-REPORT-NAME MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE TO WS-CURDATE-DATA MOVE WS-CURDATE-YEAR TO WS-START-DATE-YYYY MOVE WS-CURDATE-MONTH TO WS-START-DATE-MM MOVE '01' TO WS-START-DATE-DD MOVE WS-START-DATE TO PARM-START-DATE-1 PARM-START-DATE-2 MOVE 1 TO WS-CURDATE-DAY ADD 1 TO WS-CURDATE-MONTH IF WS-CURDATE-MONTH > 12 ADD 1 TO WS-CURDATE-YEAR MOVE 1 TO WS-CURDATE-MONTH END-IF COMPUTE WS-CURDATE-N = FUNCTION DATE-OF-INTEGER( FUNCTION INTEGER-OF-DATE(WS-CURDATE-N) - 1) MOVE WS-CURDATE-YEAR TO WS-END-DATE-YYYY MOVE WS-CURDATE-MONTH TO WS-END-DATE-MM MOVE WS-CURDATE-DAY TO WS-END-DATE-DD MOVE WS-END-DATE TO PARM-END-DATE-1 PARM-END-DATE-2 PERFORM SUBMIT-JOB-TO-INTRDR ``` - When MONTHLYI is selected, automatically calculates the first and last day of the current month as start/end dates. --- **6. Processing the YEARLY Report Selection** ```cobol WHEN YEARLYI OF CORPT0AI NOT = SPACES AND LOW-VALUES MOVE 'Yearly' TO WS-REPORT-NAME MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE TO WS-CURDATE-DATA MOVE WS-CURDATE-YEAR TO WS-START-DATE-YYYY WS-END-DATE-YYYY MOVE '01' TO WS-START-DATE-MM WS-START-DATE-DD MOVE WS-START-DATE TO PARM-START-DATE-1 PARM-START-DATE-2 MOVE '12' TO WS-END-DATE-MM MOVE '31' TO WS-END-DATE-DD MOVE WS-END-DATE TO PARM-END-DATE-1 PARM-END-DATE-2 PERFORM SUBMIT-JOB-TO-INTRDR ``` - When YEARLYI is selected, sets start date to January 1st and end date to December 31st of the current year. --- **7. Processing the CUSTOM Report Selection - Validation** ```cobol WHEN CUSTOMI OF CORPT0AI NOT = SPACES AND LOW-VALUES EVALUATE TRUE WHEN SDTMMI OF CORPT0AI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES MOVE 'Start Date - Month can NOT be empty...' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE -1 TO SDTMML OF CORPT0AI PERFORM SEND-TRNRPT-SCREEN WHEN SDTDDI OF CORPT0AI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES MOVE 'Start Date - Day can NOT be empty...' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE -1 TO SDTDDL OF CORPT0AI PERFORM SEND-TRNRPT-SCREEN WHEN SDTYYYYI OF CORPT0AI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES MOVE 'Start Date - Year can NOT be empty...' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE -1 TO SDTYYYYL OF CORPT0AI PERFORM SEND-TRNRPT-SCREEN WHEN EDTMMI OF CORPT0AI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES MOVE 'End Date - Month can NOT be empty...' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE -1 TO EDTMML OF CORPT0AI PERFORM SEND-TRNRPT-SCREEN WHEN EDTDDI OF CORPT0AI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES MOVE 'End Date - Day can NOT be empty...' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE -1 TO EDTDDL OF CORPT0AI PERFORM SEND-TRNRPT-SCREEN WHEN EDTYYYYI OF CORPT0AI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES MOVE 'End Date - Year can NOT be empty...' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE -1 TO EDTYYYYL OF CORPT0AI PERFORM SEND-TRNRPT-SCREEN END-EVALUATE ``` - Validates that all six date fields (SDTMMI, SDTDDI, SDTYYYYI, EDTMMI, EDTDDI, EDTYYYYI) are not empty when Custom is selected. --- **8. Custom Date - Numeric and Range Validation** ```cobol IF SDTMMI OF CORPT0AI IS NOT NUMERIC OR SDTMMI OF CORPT0AI > '12' MOVE 'Start Date - Not a valid Month...' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE -1 TO SDTMML OF CORPT0AI PERFORM SEND-TRNRPT-SCREEN END-IF IF SDTDDI OF CORPT0AI IS NOT NUMERIC OR SDTDDI OF CORPT0AI > '31' MOVE 'Start Date - Not a valid Day...' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE -1 TO SDTDDL OF CORPT0AI PERFORM SEND-TRNRPT-SCREEN END-IF IF SDTYYYYI OF CORPT0AI IS NOT NUMERIC MOVE 'Start Date - Not a valid Year...' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE -1 TO SDTYYYYL OF CORPT0AI PERFORM SEND-TRNRPT-SCREEN END-IF IF EDTMMI OF CORPT0AI IS NOT NUMERIC OR EDTMMI OF CORPT0AI > '12' MOVE 'End Date - Not a valid Month...' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE -1 TO EDTMML OF CORPT0AI PERFORM SEND-TRNRPT-SCREEN END-IF IF EDTDDI OF CORPT0AI IS NOT NUMERIC OR EDTDDI OF CORPT0AI > '31' MOVE 'End Date - Not a valid Day...' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE -1 TO EDTDDL OF CORPT0AI PERFORM SEND-TRNRPT-SCREEN END-IF IF EDTYYYYI OF CORPT0AI IS NOT NUMERIC MOVE 'End Date - Not a valid Year...' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE -1 TO EDTYYYYL OF CORPT0AI PERFORM SEND-TRNRPT-SCREEN END-IF ``` - Validates that each date component is numeric and within acceptable ranges, setting cursor on the offending field and displaying an error in ERRMSGO. --- **9. Processing the CONFIRM Field** ```cobol SUBMIT-JOB-TO-INTRDR. IF CONFIRMI OF CORPT0AI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES STRING 'Please confirm to print the ' DELIMITED BY SIZE WS-REPORT-NAME DELIMITED BY SPACE ' report...' DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO WS-MESSAGE MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE -1 TO CONFIRML OF CORPT0AI PERFORM SEND-TRNRPT-SCREEN END-IF IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON EVALUATE TRUE WHEN CONFIRMI OF CORPT0AI = 'Y' OR 'y' CONTINUE WHEN CONFIRMI OF CORPT0AI = 'N' OR 'n' PERFORM INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG PERFORM SEND-TRNRPT-SCREEN WHEN OTHER STRING '"' DELIMITED BY SIZE CONFIRMI OF CORPT0AI DELIMITED BY SPACE '" is not a valid value to confirm...' DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO WS-MESSAGE MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE -1 TO CONFIRML OF CORPT0AI PERFORM SEND-TRNRPT-SCREEN END-EVALUATE END-IF. ``` - Checks CONFIRMI: if empty, prompts user to confirm; if 'Y'/'y', proceeds to submit; if 'N'/'n', cancels and resets; if invalid, shows error. --- **10. Displaying Success Message in ERRMSG Field** ```cobol IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON PERFORM INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS MOVE DFHGREEN TO ERRMSGC OF CORPT0AO STRING WS-REPORT-NAME DELIMITED BY SPACE ' report submitted for printing ...' DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO WS-MESSAGE MOVE -1 TO MONTHLYL OF CORPT0AI PERFORM SEND-TRNRPT-SCREEN END-IF. ``` - After successful job submission, sets ERRMSGC to green and displays a success message in the ERRMSG field. --- **11. Initializing All Screen Input Fields** ```cobol INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS. MOVE -1 TO MONTHLYL OF CORPT0AI INITIALIZE MONTHLYI OF CORPT0AI YEARLYI OF CORPT0AI CUSTOMI OF CORPT0AI SDTMMI OF CORPT0AI SDTDDI OF CORPT0AI SDTYYYYI OF CORPT0AI EDTMMI OF CORPT0AI EDTDDI OF CORPT0AI EDTYYYYI OF CORPT0AI CONFIRMI OF CORPT0AI WS-MESSAGE. ``` - Resets all user-input fields on the screen and clears the message area. --- **12. Handling Invalid Key Press** ```cobol WHEN OTHER MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE -1 TO MONTHLYL OF CORPT0AI MOVE CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY TO WS-MESSAGE PERFORM SEND-TRNRPT-SCREEN ``` - When an unsupported key is pressed, displays the invalid key message in ERRMSGO and repositions cursor to MONTHLY field. --- **13. Handling No Report Type Selected** ```cobol WHEN OTHER MOVE 'Select a report type to print report...' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE -1 TO MONTHLYL OF CORPT0AI PERFORM SEND-TRNRPT-SCREEN ``` - If Enter is pressed without selecting any report type, displays an error message in ERRMSGO and positions cursor on MONTHLY.

TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE -1 TO MONTHLYL OF CORPT0AI PERFORM SEND-TRNRPT-SCREEN END-EVALUATE. ``` Confirm Successful Write and Advance to Next JCL Record-L1: ```cobol EVALUATE WS-RESP-CD WHEN DFHRESP(NORMAL) CONTINUE END-EVALUATE ``` Complete Batch Job Submission-L1: ```cobol IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON PERFORM INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS MOVE DFHGREEN TO ERRMSGC OF CORPT0AO STRING WS-REPORT-NAME DELIMITED BY SPACE ' report submitted for printing ...'
